Priya: Heads-up — noticed conversion on the launch-post cohort fell ~15% after Monday's posts. Dashboard shows spike in "direct" channel. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
Marco: link?
Priya: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/campaigns?cohort=launch-week — hover on "channel" stack, direct jumps from 22% -> 45% Mon->Tue.
Jules: could be attribution window change or GA4 sample rate. We flipped a default param last week.
Sam: can you paste the raw query? I'll run it against raw leads table.
Priya: here's the filter I'm using:
```
SELECT channel, count(*) as leads
FROM leads
WHERE campaign = 'launch-week' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-16' AND '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY channel;
```
launch-bot: campaign:launch-week tags updated by @marketing-ops at 2026-03-17 09:02 UTC — added medium=organic fallback.
Marco: ah, that medium fallback would push a bunch to "direct" if utm_medium missing. :facepalm: \nPriya: I remember some social posts used shortlinks without UTM. likely culprit.
Jules: also check inbound routing rules — some Slack-to-leads testers hit the webhook with no utm, they get routed to direct.
ops-bot: export ready: https://s3.redwood.com/exports/3956789012-launch-raw.csv
Sam: pulling now. quick check — run this and ping results:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM leads_raw
WHERE campaign='launch-week' AND (utm_medium IS NULL OR utm_medium = '');
```
Marco: if that's >200, we should backfill UTMs and re-run attribution.
Priya: ok team — Sam will run the query, Marco/ J to prepare backfill script. I'll update the weekly KPI deck with a note and hold the attribution call til we confirm. :raised_hands: 
Jules: assigning to Sam for counts, Marco for backfill. tag me if you need db creds.
Sam: got it. will post results here in ~10m.
Priya: thanks — also schedule a 15-min sync after results, don't let this block Friday KPI review.
